The findings are characteristic of prostatic hyperplasia.

random.description: This image is a gross pathology specimen of uterine tissue, likely representing an endometrial lesion or polyp. The cut surface shows a well-circumscribed, fleshy mass with alternating areas of whitish-pink tissue and darker hemorrhagic or necrotic regions. The specimen is presented alongside a measurement scale to indicate its size. The appearance is consistent with a large endometrial polyp, potentially of a senile type.
